Tohatsu outboard repair and service in Tampa Bay

Tohatsu powers a lot of skiffs, dinghies, and kicker setups on the bay, and also builds engines sold under other names. Small-engine specialists in the network keep them running.

Models we see most
MFS 2.5 through MFS 140, and Nissan-branded twins
Service intervals
100 hours or annually; water pump every 2 years.
Parts and diagnostics
Parts flow through Tohatsu dealers and online; many Mercury small-engine parts cross over.

What goes wrong on Tohatsu engines here

  • Carburetor varnish from ethanol in small carbureted models
  • Water pump impellers
  • Pull-start and ignition issues on portables
  • Fuel connector and primer bulb leaks

Questions we get

Is it worth repairing a small Tohatsu?

Usually yes; a carburetor clean and impeller on a 20-horse is a fraction of a new engine.
